title: Flow chemistry synthesis and sustvdainability assessment for choline chloride, a deep eutectic solvent constituent
content:

Marc Escribà-Gelonch, Volker Hessel, Nguyen Van Duc Long, Ramon Canela-Garayoa
A 1 min continuous flow process produces 99% pure choline chloride from waste biomass, boosting productivity ×20. Using choline hydroxide prevents byproducts and cuts energy use and environmental impact, enhancing global material circularity.
